Buy Tenda F3 Wireless Router Online in Bangladesh – Fast & Affordable

Experience seamless internet connectivity across your home or small office with the Tenda F3 300Mbps Wireless Router, one of the most popular and affordable routers in Bangladesh. Designed for everyday users, this router provides high-speed wireless performance, wide coverage, and easy setup, making it perfect for streaming, online classes, video calls, and web browsing.

With three 5dBi external antennas, the Tenda F3 ensures strong signal strength and stable connectivity in every room. Its 300Mbps transmission speed on 2.4GHz allows multiple users to enjoy uninterrupted internet without lag. Whether you're in Dhaka, Chattogram, or anywhere else in Bangladesh, the Tenda F3 offers a cost-effective way to upgrade your home network.

It also supports bandwidth control, secure WPA/WPA2 encryption, and multiple modes (Router / WISP / Access Point), giving you more flexibility and control over your network. Perfect for students, families, and home offices.
